name: web-tilted-pinned-step-cards-with-numbered-colour-headers-and-dashed-path
title: Five tilted white step cards pinned with coloured push pins, each with a coloured number and tint, joined by a dashed path
whatItIs: A white page where five soft-shadow cards are placed in a staggered diagonal and rotated slightly, each with a coloured push pin, a large coloured number (01 orange, 02 blue, 03 purple, 04 orange, 05 blue), a bold title (Create Account, Verify Identity, Select Plan, Analyze & Invest, Track Growth), a short grey description in a tinted top area, and a dashed line linking them.
whatItMeans: Playful and clear; pins and tilt make a process feel like notes on a board.
techniques: Tint each step in its own pastel.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a pin graphic at the top.
A top area of a card with a soft colour.
